note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after 9d4a5e79e2). Section 8.3: "For configuration data, there are three windows when constraints MUST be enforced": parsing, processing of <edit-config>, and validation. Parse and whole-tree validation stay proven through LoadConfig (TestRFC7950RunningDatastoreRefusesAViolationAtParse, ...AfterParse). The earlier finding (edit-processing window untested) is answered for the web editor: TestRFC7950WebCommitWritesAValidEdit (SetValue, CommitNow, file carries the edit) and TestRFC7950WebCommitRefusesAConstraintViolation (a value the YANG type accepts and the internal-plugin ze:validate rule refuses: CommitNow errors naming the value and the file is byte-identical), driven through newEditorFactory(ValidateContent), the factory service_web.go installs. Residual: the SSH CLI editor commit, which carries no pre-commit validator and is refused only at reload, and the gNMI/API session commit are not driven by a tagged unit.
